verdict.rationale: Vercel ships an official, documented CLI (`npm i -g vercel`, `vercel login`) for driving the platform from a terminal or automated system: logs, certificates, DNS, local environment replication, and more. It also has explicitly AI-native commands: `vercel agent init` writes deployment best practices into AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md, `vercel skills` discovers agent skills, and eve Agent Runs are exposed via the CLI. The agent onboarding playbook lists the CLI as a supported surface and tells coding agents to install and run it themselves. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of the CLI's agent-driven use, and evidence of machine-readable (e.g. JSON) output modes for agents.
